headline: Integer Holdings Stockholders Approve KKR Acquisition Proposals
summary: Integer Holdings Corporation stockholders approved proposals in connection with KKR's proposed acquisition of the company.
why: M&A transactions involving private equity firms often result in significant valuation re-ratings and immediate arbitrage opportunities for shareholders of the target company.

impacts.name: Integer Holdings Corporation
impacts.why: Shareholder approval moves the buyout transaction closer to final completion.

why_moved: Approval of buyout terms reduces regulatory and procedural uncertainty regarding the acquisition deal.
